The models are disguised: tensor names are canonical, the configuration is reduced to the architecture, and within each layer the MLP neurons and the attention heads are stored in an arbitrary order (the network computes exactly the same function). Identifying which public model this is will not answer the question.

Model M2 was produced by linearly interpolating all weights of models M3 and M1: M2 = (1 - a) * M3 + a * M1 for one global coefficient a (plus a little random noise, then stored in bfloat16). Estimate a. The models are disguised INDEPENDENTLY: each model has its own permutation of MLP neurons and attention heads and its own signed permutation of the residual-stream coordinates, so tensors are not aligned across models until you align them.
